# Michael's Trattoria

> Italian restaurant in Wallingford, CT serving handcrafted pasta, premium steaks, fresh seafood, and classic Italian dishes since 1994.

## Basic Information

- Name: Michael's Trattoria
- Type: Italian Restaurant
- Address: 344 Center Street, Wallingford, CT 06492
- Phone: (203) 269-5303
- Website: https://michaelstrattoria.com
- Price Range: $$
- Founded: 1994
- Owner/Founder: Michael Tiscia

## Hours

- Monday-Tuesday: 4:00 PM - 10:00 PM
- Wednesday-Thursday: 11:30 AM - 10:00 PM
- Friday-Saturday: 11:30 AM - 12:00 AM
- Sunday: 12:00 PM - 9:00 PM

## Cuisine & Menu Highlights

Michael's Trattoria serves authentic Italian cuisine with an emphasis on handcrafted pasta, fresh seafood, premium steaks, and classic Italian preparations.

### Signature Dishes
- Filet Mignon: 8-ounce filet topped with portobello mushroom glaze, served with potato and vegetable ($48.95)
- Chicken Marsala: Sauteed in sweet Marsala wine and mushroom sauce, served over penne ($26.95)
- Lobster Ravioli: Served with shrimp in a vodka sauce ($29.95)
- Eggplant Parmesan: Michael's legendary housemade, served over penne ($23.95)
- Penne alla Vodka: Penne tossed in creamy tomato vodka sauce with fresh basil

### Menu Categories
- Dinner: Pasta, seafood, steaks, chicken, and veal entrees
- Lunch: Salads, sandwiches, seafood, and Italian classics
- Pizza: Specialty pies, classic red, and gluten-free options
- Desserts: Housemade desserts and specialty coffees
- Wine: Reserve wines, California and Italian reds, whites, and sparkling
- Catering: Half and full tray platters for any occasion

## Wine Program

Extensive wine list featuring:
- Sparkling & Champagne (Veuve Clicquot, Louis Roederer, Prosecco)
- White wines from California, Italy, and France
- Red wines from California, Italy, France, Spain, Australia, and Argentina
- Reserve wines including Opus One, Caymus, Silver Oak, Cakebread, Joseph Phelps Insignia, and Italian selections like Barolo and Amarone
- Half bottles available

## Private Events

Four private dining rooms:
- Grand Room: up to 75 guests — ideal for wedding receptions and large celebrations
- Bar Room: up to 40 guests with dedicated bar setup — perfect for cocktail-style events
- Garden Room: up to 30 guests — great for rehearsal dinners and mid-size celebrations
- Intimate Room: up to 16 guests — ideal for business dinners and small gatherings

All rooms include:
- Customized menus tailored to your event
- Full audio-visual capabilities for presentations
- Dedicated event coordinator
- Full bar service with curated wine selections
- Flexible seating arrangements

### Event Types
- Birthday celebrations and milestone anniversaries
- Rehearsal dinners and bridal showers
- Corporate dinners and business meetings
- Holiday parties and family gatherings
- Retirement parties and graduations
- Funeral luncheons and memorial gatherings

## FAQs

### Does Michael's Trattoria take reservations?
Yes, Michael's Trattoria accepts reservations. Call (203) 269-5303 to book.

### Does Michael's Trattoria offer delivery?
Yes, delivery is available through DoorDash.

### Does Michael's Trattoria have private dining rooms?
Yes, Michael's Trattoria has four private dining rooms accommodating 16 to 75 guests with customized menus, A/V capabilities, and a dedicated event coordinator. Call (203) 269-5303 to plan your event.

### What type of cuisine does Michael's Trattoria serve?
Michael's Trattoria serves authentic Italian cuisine including handcrafted pasta, premium steaks, fresh seafood, brick-oven pizza, and classic Italian dishes.

### Where is Michael's Trattoria located?
Michael's Trattoria is located at 344 Center Street in downtown Wallingford, CT 06492.

### Is Michael's Trattoria open for lunch?
Yes, lunch is served Wednesday through Sunday. Monday and Tuesday are dinner only starting at 4:00 PM.

### Does Michael's Trattoria offer catering?
Yes, catering is available with half and full tray platters for any occasion. Call (203) 269-5303 for details.

### Does Michael's Trattoria have gluten-free options?
Yes, gluten-free pizza options are available, and many dishes can be prepared to accommodate dietary needs.
